blocks.text: Mr. Justin Sy Uy, Chairman of Jpark Island Resort & Waterpark and President of Profood International Corporation, welcomed President Ferdinand “Bongbong” R. Marcos Jr. during the Public Employment Service Office (PESO) Congress and the launch of Trabahong Dagat, an initiative of the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE). The event highlighted efforts to strengthen employment services and expand livelihood opportunities for Filipinos, particularly in the maritime sector. The launch of Trabahong Dagat underscores the importance of connecting Filipino workers with employment opportunities and supporting the continued development of the country’s maritime workforce.
